title: Pantheon Persona
description: Registry persona object — the static, governance truth for a persona's identity, mandate, and policy references.

persona_id.description: Immutable unique identifier for this persona.

mandate.description: Operating mandate — strategy scope and constraints for this persona.

strategy_family.description: Optional strategy family tag (e.g. momentum, mean_reversion).

workspace_ref.description: Reference to this persona's private workspace.

tool_profile_id.description: Reference to the persona's tool profile. Resolved at session time into a CapabilitySnapshot.

route_policy_id.description: Reference to the route policy document. Resolved at session time.

consult_policy_id.description: Reference to the consult policy document. Enforced at session creation.

owner.description: Governance operator who owns this persona record.

status.description: Administrative status of this persona record.
